post_train_eval: tools/ssenv python -m ss_splatfactow.evaluate --run RUN   (writes RUN/test_sfw.json; HEADLINE = metrics.nerfw = right half of the NeRF-W test views; ss-eval / validation.json are full-image numbers and NOT the paper protocol)
baseline: no shared gsplat baseline on Photo Tourism; optional reference: gsplat on phototourism-sfw with the same extra args (score with ss_splatfactow.evaluate is not possible for gsplat - use full-image validation.json); compare to paper's 3DGS row 19.99 / 17.57
notes: phototourism-sfw registered in tools/datasets.json (built by tools/prepare_sfw.py on /bigdata via the ~/datasets/phototourism symlink). Iterations: code config 55000 (paper text 65000). Put runs under /bigdata/sejain/runs with a symlink. ~6.6 GB host RAM per run (full-res images). Check that the sfw-alpha loss becomes nonzero in training.jsonl. After training, report checkpoint density_state.counters.alpha_active_steps / alpha_selected_pixels (and the per-step sfw-alpha-selected-frac in training.jsonl); if 0 through 55k, state that the C3 alpha loss was inactive. The logged total 'loss' includes the gradient-free diagnostic fraction (<= 1).
